title: Inherited Wage Dispersion and Optimal Discretion in a Dual-Rigidity TANK Model
abstract: arXiv:2609.39070v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: How does an inherited cross-type wage gap enter Markov-perfect discretionary monetary policy when transfers are passive? In a two-agent New Keynesian model with sticky prices and type-specific own-lag wage adjustment, the gap changes implementable allocations and the second-order welfare loss. A positive lower bound establishes its value relevance; explicit rank conditions characterize when current price inflation, wage inflation, and the output gap fail to determine the implementing nominal rate. An illustrative parameterization satisfies these conditions, although the additional state explains little nominal-rate variance after conditioning on all three aggregate variables. Welfare comparisons with fixed rules are driven mainly by aggregate wage-inflation stabilization and do not isolate the value of distributional information. Unrestricted targeted transfers separate aggregate allocation from the legacy wage-gap transition. In the CES

translated_title: 双重粘性TANK模型中的继承性工资离散与最优相机抉择
translated_abstract: 在转移支付被动的情况下，历史遗留的跨类型工资差距如何进入马尔科夫完美相机抉择的货币政策？本文在一个具有粘性价格和类型特定自身滞后工资调整的两代理人新凯恩斯（TANK）模型中研究表明，该工资差距会改变可实现的资源配置和二阶福利损失。一个正的下界确立了其价值相关性；显式的秩条件刻画了当期价格通胀、工资通胀和产出缺口在何时无法确定实施所需的名义利率。一个示例性参数化满足这些条件，尽管在以全部三个总量变量为条件后，这一额外状态对名义利率方差的解释力很小。与固定规则的福利比较主要由总量工资通胀的稳定所驱动，并不能分离出分配性信息的价值。无约束的定向转移支付则可以将总量配置与遗留工资差距的动态演化分离开来。
tldr: 本文在价格与类型特定工资双重粘性的两代理人新凯恩斯模型中证明，当转移支付被动时，继承的跨类型工资差距是马尔科夫完美最优相机抉择货币政策中具有价值相关性的额外状态变量，其能否由价格通胀、工资通胀和产出缺口确定实施利率由显式秩条件刻画，而无约束的定向转移支付可将总量配置与遗留工资差距的演化相分离。
en_tdlr: In a dual-rigidity TANK model with passive transfers, an inherited cross-type wage gap acts as a value-relevant extra state for Markov-perfect optimal discretion, with explicit rank conditions determining when price inflation, wage inflation, and the output gap fail to pin down the implementing nominal rate, while unrestricted targeted transfers can decouple aggregate allocation from the legacy wage-gap transition.
